extra.frozen_placement: Generic support (frozen timing12 templates), result selection, packed positions, masks and prompts as in kvmix12. A's cached states and the base-model weights are never modified. Plan 384 / answer 48 tokens, greedy, thinking disabled.
extra.kernel_note: Training forwards (teacher and student) use memory-efficient attention because eager attention keeps every layer's attention matrix for the backward pass, which does not fit on a T4. Generation and evaluation stay on eager attention, as in every earlier run; agreement between the two kernels is reported.

protocol.question: Can a small receiver-side query adjustment improve B's use of the transferred cache when no reference model supplies attention or answers?
protocol.basis: Adapts Attuner (arXiv 2609.36722, Section 4) to the transferred twelve-carrier cache. Motivated by the fresh-key result (63 -> 94 labels in free generation with transferred values kept). The oracle's 106/108 is reference-guided recovery, not evidence that B reads the transferred values, and is not a basis for expecting a similar repair.
amendments_before_training: Prep check: support token IDs must match within a template; support tensors are reported against the template's first sheet instead of required to be byte-identical (opening positions are re-prefilled per sheet in different-length FP16 forwards). Mismatched R therefore uses each sheet's own support plus the partner's R rather than the partner's whole cache. No training or evaluation had been run.

Training forwards (teacher logits and student) use memory-efficient (sdpa) attention, because eager attention keeps every layer's attention matrix for the backward pass and does not fit on a T4. Generation, selection and evaluation stay on eager attention, as in all earlier runs; kernel agreement is reported by the implementation check. No training had been run.

Targets are the saved teacher plan and answer texts re-tokenized, followed by EOS when the teacher was not truncated; alignment with the teacher's own forced predictions is checked. A sheet's loss is the KL summed over its plan and answer response tokens divided by their total count (plan and answer backpropagate separately); each sheet's loss is divided by 4 within an optimizer step. Dynamic loss scaling starts at 1024 with default growth and backoff; a step skipped for overflow is counted, not repeated.

Before training, a separate implementation check on the first 4 training base sheets (3 optimizer steps) verifies zero-initialised reproduction, gradients on adapter parameters only, finite loss, unchanged received caches, and the absence of the teacher plan from the plan-pass input. Its adapter and optimizer are reset and nothing from it is saved or used for selection.

data.a_flip: One carrier's operational facts change in A's document only (make the trap eligible, or make the gold ineligible), balanced per level; B's document is identical within a pair.
data.eval_a_sheets: not generated until the candidate is frozen
data.diagnostic_only: data/plan4_timing12.jsonl (the nine reused cases): never trained on, never used for selection, never presented as confirmation

protocol.frozen_construction: Generic support (frozen timing12 templates), result selection, packed positions, masks and prompts as in kvmix12. A's cached states and the base-model weights are never modified. Plan 384 / answer 48 tokens, greedy, thinking disabled.
protocol.teacher: fk_fv: generic support + R recomputed after that support (reconstructed result states); used only to make training targets

adapter.init: A Kaiming-uniform, B zero (adapted model starts identical to the base model)
adapter.applies_to: B's own prompt and generated tokens; the received cache is never recomputed
adapter.dtype: fp32 adapter parameters on the fp16 base, dynamic loss scaling (T4 has no bf16)

training.targets: teacher plan and answer text generated once (prep stage), unfiltered; answer prompt contains the teacher's plan
training.loss: token-mean KL(stopgrad p_teacher || p_student) over teacher response tokens (EOS included when not truncated), full vocabulary, fp32 log-softmax; teacher logits come from fk_fv on the same prompt and response
training.optimizer: AdamW, lr 2e-4, betas (0.9, 0.999), weight decay 0, constant schedule, no warmup, gradient clip 1.0
training.batch: one sheet (plan + answer sequences) per micro-step, 4 sheets per optimizer step (24 steps per epoch)
training.checkpoints: end of epochs 1, 2, 3; no other checkpoints are evaluated

selection.data: dev base sheets (12 sheets, 144 labels), free generation, adapted tk_tv, no reference at evaluation
selection.rule: highest eligibility labels correct; ties go to the earlier epoch
selection.single_use: selection uses dev base only; nothing on eval is computed before the candidate is frozen

evaluation_conditions.mismatched_r: this sheet's own generic support followed by the partner's transferred R tensors at the same packed positions (result_start is 70 on every sheet), with this sheet's B prompt; partner is the next base family at the same level in file order (cyclic), listed in data_summary.json
evaluation_conditions.no_r: generic support only (cache positions before result_start), same B prompt
evaluation_conditions.a_flip_pairs: base and a_flip sheets share B's document; only A's message differs
evaluation_conditions.primary: eligibility labels (12 per sheet), with both error directions, missing lines, parse failures and truncation

advance_rule_dev: adapted labels >= unadapted tk_tv labels + 12 (of 144) on dev base, and the 95% cluster-bootstrap interval over the 12 families excludes zero
adapted correct-R labels exceed adapted no-R labels by at least 12
on carriers whose status differs between a sheet and its mismatch partner, adapted labels under mismatched R follow the partner's status more often than the sheet's own
A-change pairs with the changed carrier labelled correctly in both members: adapted >= unadapted
parse failures plus plan truncations: adapted no more than unadapted + 1
protocol.confirmation: Only if every advance condition holds: freeze the selected checkpoint, write eval A sheets, run all conditions once on eval (24 base + 24 a_flip). Report all results whatever they show.
protocol.dev_outcome: All five dev gates passed (adapted 144 vs unadapted 94 of 144; no-R 83; mismatched follows partner 57 vs own 5 of 62; A-change pairs 12 vs 3; malformed 0 vs 0). All three epochs scored 144, so the registered tie rule selected epoch 1.
amendments_before_eval: Full KV (A's complete cache rebuilt from its saved token IDs, as in timing12; unadapted) is added as a reference on eval base and a_flip, so the adapted receiver can be compared against reconstruction, full KV and text. Added after the dev gates and before any eval A sheet was written.
The selected checkpoint (epoch 1) is hashed into frozen_candidate.json before eval A sheets are written; every eval row records the hash, and the run refuses a changed checkpoint.

The registered dev gates are recomputed on eval and reported; nothing is selected from them. Paired comparisons use the family-level cluster bootstrap (2000 draws, seed 2026): adapted vs unadapted, fk_fv, full KV, text, and adapted no-R.

Overhead is reported as decode seconds per generated token and prefill seconds, adapted vs unadapted on the same caches, plus resident cache positions per condition. No cost advantage is claimed from reliability.
costs_to_report: training wall time and peak memory
receiver prefill and decode time with and without the adapter
note: the sender must run without the adapter, so a merged receiver needs its own q_proj weights or adapter switching
protocol.dest: results_stage_plan4_qadapt_prep (preparation); later stages get their own folders
